# Section 0: Current Positions & Hypotheses

As of August 20, 2026 (pre-market, ~8:35 AM CT). Research framework, not trade recommendations.

**Book snapshot (default ••••770):** Cash $109.0K (102.8% of account — short book funds it) · net delta ≈ -36% (net short) · premium at risk 26.6% · theta ≈ -$230/day (-0.22%/day). Account value $106.1K · equities -$29.8K net short · long options $26.9K.
**Model risk appetite:** Last reading GPT 6/10 (Risk-on) · Grok 4/10 (Neutral) · Fable 8/10 (Risk-on). Today's engine refresh pending (grok-risk-daily runs separately).
**Overnight book changes:** AAON equity closed out (50 sh gone, was -6.9%); HIMS/FIGR/OSCR trackers retired. **PAYX short opened** (-75 sh @ $122.20 + 6× Jan '27 $105 puts — first true valuation short besides DASH). LYV short sized 50→70 sh with puts doubled to 12×; DASH puts 5→7×; TOST short now put-protected (10× Jan '27 $32 puts). AVAV onboarded as a tracker.

## 1. CTVA — seed & crop-protection, split catalyst (hold, options-led)

**Price:** $78.57 close / $78.00 pre-market (wide $77×$80) | RSI(14): 45.1 | MACD histogram: -0.18
**Valuation:** Market cap $52.4B | PE 51.9× | P/B 2.1× | Div yield 0.9% | 52w range $60.54–$90.97 (high Jul 29)
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 18 ref / 52W high):** Bear $60.56 | Base $78.07 | Bull $90.51
**Thesis:** Seed pricing and crop-protection productivity into the September investor days and October Vylor spin — two investable companies without operational disruption or stranded costs.
**Holdings:** 50× Sep 18 '26 $85 calls @ $0.385 (mark $0.40, IV 24.5%, delta 0.15, break-even $85.40) + 1 sh tracker @ $77.79.
**Latest:** Yahoo Finance argues 32% undervalued after debt exchange offers (Aug 19); UBS cut PT to $85 on 2027 growth outlook (Aug 18) — target still above break-even; Great Lake Advisors disclosed a 61K-share buy (Aug 20).
**Catalyst:** September investor days + October Vylor spin · ex-div Sep 1 · **option expiry Sep 18 — 29 DTE, theta now the clock**
**Kill watch:** Price pinned at base $78.07; RSI 45 neutral, MACD still negative. Ref R/R remains the worst in the long book (~0.7×) — the position lives or dies on the spin catalyst landing inside 29 days.
**Action:** Hold — catalyst-driven; treat $75 as the add/exit decision line.

![CTVA MACD](charts/2026-08-20/ctva-macd.png)

## 2. FRMI — development-stage AI infrastructure (hold; thesis just got its first proof)

**Price:** $5.76 close / $5.80 pre-market (+0.7%) | RSI(14): 43.2 | MACD histogram: -0.03
**Valuation:** Market cap $3.69B | P/B 3.6× | Pre-revenue | 52w range $4.47–$36.99
**Entry levels (52W low / cost basis / call-strike refs):** Bear $4.47 | Base $7.26 | Bull $15.00
**Thesis:** Project Matador becoming a scarce, gigawatt-scale powered AI campus near Amarillo. Commercial agreements and funded delivery — not headline capacity — must validate it.
**Holdings:** 500 sh @ $6.56 (-12%) + 10× Dec '28 $10 calls @ $3.676 (mark $2.43, IV 94.7%, delta 0.66, break-even $12.43).
**Latest:** 🚨 **First AI data-center lease signed — $6.5B, 15-year contract** (Moomoo/Seeking Alpha, ~Aug 13; Barron's: the big move already happened). This is the funded-customer proof the thesis has been waiting for since April.
**Catalyst:** Additional lease/power agreements; construction milestones at Amarillo.
**Kill watch:** Price 21% below base $7.26; bear ref $4.47 is -23%. RSI 43 drifting, MACD flat — the lease pop faded fast. First lease is necessary, not sufficient.

![FRMI RSI](charts/2026-08-20/frmi-rsi.png)

![FRMI MACD](charts/2026-08-20/frmi-macd.png)

## 3. BRBR — branded protein (hold via calls only)

**Price:** $10.73 close / ~$10.70 pre-market | RSI(14): 39.7 | MACD histogram: -0.24
**Valuation:** Market cap $1.25B | PE 7.3× (depressed earnings) | 52w range $7.82–$43.02
**Entry levels (1Y low / Aug 12 close / 1Y high):** Bear $7.90 | Base $10.85 | Bull $42.68
**Thesis:** Company-specific margin recovery, not a generic GLP-1 play. Pricing/productivity must restore margin without breaking demand.
**Holdings:** 3× Jan '28 $12.50 calls @ $3.80 (mark $3.50, IV 77.6%, delta 0.64, break-even $16.00) + 1 sh tracker @ $10.58.
**Latest:** BofA disclosed acquiring 250,144 shares (Aug 19); margin-squeeze narrative persists (Simply Wall St); institutional accumulation continues at the lows.
**Catalyst:** FQ4 earnings — est. Nov 17, 2026 (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch:** Price 1.1% below base $10.85; RSI 40 weakest long chart but price is stabilizing above $10. Kill: volumes decelerating alongside failed margin recapture.
**Action:** Hold — deep-dated calls keep the asymmetry; margin-recovery evidence is the only thing that pays.

**Price:** $184.19 close / $183.30 pre-market | RSI(14): 53.5 | MACD histogram: -0.17
**Valuation:** Market cap $43.4B | PE n/m (loss) | 52w range $125.34–$189.25 (high hit Aug 14 — fresh)
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 18 ref / 52W high):** Bear $125.61 | Base $180.74 | Bull $188.46
**Thesis (short):** Record ticket sales have run the stock to a 52-week high; the position bets demand normalization and legal/capital intensity catch up before deferred revenue converts.
**Holdings:** Short 70 sh @ $181.47 (sized from 50) + 12× Jan '27 $165 puts @ $6.05 (mark $5.90, IV 32.3%, delta -0.24, break-even $159.10) — puts doubled overnight.

**Catalyst:** Q3 earnings — early Nov (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch (short risk):** Stock sits **2.7% under the fresh 52W high** — tightest squeeze zone in the book. RSI 53.5 with MACD rolling over = momentum cooling but not broken. Downside ref $125.61 is +32% for the short.
**Action:** Hold — protection doubled; let the $165 strike define the fight ($165–189 zone).

![LYV RSI](charts/2026-08-20/lyv-rsi.png)

![LYV MACD](charts/2026-08-20/lyv-macd.png)

## 5. DASH — local-commerce multiple (hold short, puts topped up)

**Price:** $220.22 close / $218.75 pre-market (-0.7%) | RSI(14): 68.0 | MACD histogram: +0.61
**Valuation:** Market cap $95.4B | PE 115.6× | 52w range $143.30–$285.50
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 18 ref / 52W high):** Bear $146.60 | Base $215.79 | Bull $281.74
**Thesis (short):** Q2 revenue beat is digested; the position bets 116× earnings prices in perfection while regulation, insurance, and autonomy spend compress margins.
**Holdings:** Short 50 sh @ $220.04 + 7× Jan '27 $200 puts @ $14.23 (mark $14.03, IV 45.1%, delta -0.30, break-even $185.97) — puts topped up 5→7.

**Catalyst:** Q3 earnings — Nov 4 (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch (short risk):** Strongest momentum chart in the book (RSI 68, MACD +0.61). Upside ref $281.74 = -28% against the short; $200 put strike is the hard floor of the structure.
**Action:** Hold — short thesis is a multiple reset, not a break; respect the momentum, the added puts are the respect.

![DASH RSI](charts/2026-08-20/dash-rsi.png)

![DASH MACD](charts/2026-08-20/dash-macd.png)

## 6. PAYX — payroll/HCM compounder (new short, put-protected)

**Price:** $122.50 close / ~$122.49 pre-market | RSI(14): 61.1 | MACD histogram: -0.41
**Valuation:** Market cap $43.6B | PE 25.1× | Div yield 3.7% | 52w range $85.45–$141.19 (high Aug '25 — rolling over for a year)
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 18 close / 52W high):** Bear $83.61 | Base $119.93 | Bull $134.87
**Thesis (short):** FY27 adj-EPS guide of +7–9% doesn't support a 25× multiple on decelerating SMB payroll growth; the stock has spent a year distributing below its Aug '25 high.
**Holdings:** Short 75 sh @ $122.20 + 6× Jan '27 $105 puts @ $3.38 (mark $3.53, +4.4% d/d, IV 36.4%, delta -0.20, break-even $101.47).
**Latest:** "Holds above $120 as revenue growth accelerates" (Aug 20); HR-software Q2 recap live (TradingView, Aug 19); Barchart notes analysts still bullish (Aug 18). Sides split.
**Catalyst:** Q1 FY27 earnings — late Sep (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch (short risk):** RSI 61 with MACD histogram negative = momentum divergence already in place; +10% to bull ref $134.87 is the squeeze cost, capped by $105 puts. Dividend (3.7%) accrues against the short.
**Action:** Hold — freshest position; let the $105–135 range resolve. First real valuation short where both multiple AND momentum can work in our favor.

![PAYX RSI](charts/2026-08-20/payx-rsi.png)

![PAYX MACD](charts/2026-08-20/payx-macd.png)

## Mini-book (trackers, shorts, watch)

- **TOST** — short 1 sh @ $35.49 (close $34.95→$35.16, pre $35.07) **now put-protected**: 10× Jan '27 $32 puts @ $2.27 (mark $2.38, IV 46.6%, delta -0.31, break-even $29.62). RSI 64.4 — momentum strong, hence the protection. 52w $22.26–$45.64; PE 44.9×.
- **BOT** — 1 sh @ $32.67. Close $29.05, pre-market $27.80 — **-4.3% overnight bleed continues** (was +7.3% Tue). Premium-to-NAV deflation is the whole story; Aug 30 NAV checkpoint.
- **AVAV** — 1 sh @ $173.99 (new tracker). Close $172.74, pre $171.02. Defense/drone prime; thesis pending full onboard.
- **DJT** — 1 sh @ $8.07. Close $8.35, pre $8.49 (+1.7%). Event-driven media/digital-asset position pending TAE merger; refs $7.06 / $8.06 / $18.50.

- **Watch only:** MOS $22.23 close / $22.39 pre (refs $19.82/$22.60/$31.04) · XLE $63.58 close / $64.28 pre (+1.1%, at 52W high) — energy thesis still de-minimis on the desk.

## Risk/Reward ranking (reference levels; longs ranked upside-to-bull ÷ downside-to-bear)

| Rank | Ticker | Side | Price | Bear | Base | Bull | Ref R/R | Note |
|------|--------|------|-------|------|------|------|---------|------|
| 1 | FRMI | long | $5.80 | $4.47 | $7.26 | $15.00 | ~7.1× | First $6.5B lease = thesis proof; binary but contracted now |
| 2 | BRBR | long (calls) | $10.70 | $7.90 | $10.85 | $42.68 | ~11×* | *Bull ref is stale 1Y high — scenario, not target |
| 3 | CTVA | long (calls) | $78.00 | $60.56 | $78.07 | $90.51 | ~0.7× | Worst ref R/R; pure 29-day catalyst bet |
| S1 | LYV | short+puts | $183.30 | $125.61 | $180.74 | $188.46 | tightest squeeze | 2.7% from fresh 52W high; 12× $165P floor |
| S2 | DASH | short+puts | $218.75 | $146.60 | $215.79 | $281.74 | squeeze risk | RSI 68 momentum vs 116× PE; 7× $200P floor |
| S3 | PAYX | short+puts | $122.49 | $83.61 | $119.93 | $134.87 | +10% squeeze cost | RSI 61 + MACD divergence; $105P floor |

**Gemini risk notes (Aug 20):**
- ⚠️ DASH carries the highest short-squeeze risk among the shorts (RSI 68, 116× PE); LYV is also vulnerable 2.7% under its 52-week high.
- ⚠️ Negative-theta concentration is highest in the CTVA 29-DTE calls — value erodes quickly without a move into the spin.
- ⚠️ Biggest single tail risk today is FRMI's binary status: one adverse headline on the AI-campus build can reprice the calls violently.

**Engine risk note:** Yesterday's split (GPT 6 / Grok 4 / Fable 8) argued open-but-sized; overnight the book leaned harder into the short side (PAYX on, LYV sized, TOST protected) — the disagreement hedge is now the dominant structure: 103% cash, net -36% delta, every short put-capped.

*Levels are market references (52W/1Y low · recent close · 52W/1Y high), not intrinsic-value DCFs; confidence low pending refreshed net-DCF work. Catalyst dates unconfirmed except where noted.*
